items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because I played in Jimmy Coe's [band], on some situations with Coe and his band.

ctx.x: I think it came a little later.
A little later, yeah. Because I played in Jimmy Coe's [band], on some situations with Coe and his band. But that must have been a lot later because LaVon Kemp was long before Coe.
